text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! I'm so sorry your monstera arrived looking unhappy and that you've seen a double charge. Let's sort out all three things.

**1. Your monstera's yellow leaves**
- If your monstera arrived dead or severely wilted, with snapped main stems or exposed roots, that counts as damaged on arrival. We'd send a free replacement on the next plant shipping day, or a refund.
- You'll need to report it **within 48 hours of delivery**, with photos of the plant and the box.
- A few bent leaves is considered normal, so I can't say for sure whether yellowing alone qualifies. If it's past 48 hours, the Plant Care Guarantee applies instead, and I don't have its details to hand, so I can escalate that to a Support Lead.

Could you tell me when it was delivered and share photos of the plant and box?

**2. The double charge**
- First, check whether one charge is just a **pending authorisation**. Cards are authorised at checkout and charged when the order ships, and an order shipped in several parcels can show one charge per parcel.
- If both charges have fully posted, send me your **order number** and the **last four digits** of your card. The duplicate will be refunded within **3 business days** of confirmation.
- Please don't send your full card number or security code.

**3. Refunding to a different card**
Unfortunately, refunds can only go back to the **original payment method**, never a different card. If your original card has been closed or replaced, the bank normally passes the refund on to the new card. Once a refund is issued, cards take **5-10 business days** and digital wallets **3-5 business days**.

Alternatively, you can take **Leafy store credit**, which is issued instantly and never expires.

If you have any questions, I'm happy to help. Your plant is in good hands! 🌿
